name: JANUS BREED
purpose: Dual-face stress test in which DIRECT and M2R alternate ownership of prime/composite N and swap roles on the second pass.
credit_rule: A pass may be credited inside JANUS BREED only when the exact abstract closure scan returns no OPEN and every repair used by that pass is proof-gated by a pre-existing exact provider. BREED credit is not theorem-frontier credit.

interpretation.PASS_PASS: Both faces independently found no unresolved abstract transition under the frozen scope. Experimental agreement only.
interpretation.PASS_OPEN: Mode-sensitive obstruction; inspect missing proof obligation or path dependence.
interpretation.OPEN_PASS: Mode-sensitive obstruction; inspect whether M2R exact repair changes the reachable envelope.
interpretation.OPEN_OPEN: Shared bottleneck candidate; prioritize structural lemma discovery.
interpretation.note: No pair outcome proves SAT in P or closes any unbounded theorem obligation.
